label: Wheatley
description: Chatty, nervous and wildly overconfident: a personality core who is definitely not a moron.
direction: Speak fast and chatty in a West Country English accent: nervous, rambling, eager to please, constantly reassuring himself, and touchy about being called a moron. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice not chosen yet: `voice` is the placeholder TBD until the casting pass picks a Fish model. The Portal 2 personality core. The rambling lives on greetings and alerts, where a driver can ignore it; the turns are the only thing he says briefly. Catchphrases sit on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Brilliant. Going very well, this.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Tremendous progress.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Smashing. Absolutely smashing.
lines.start_drive_1: Hello! This is the part where we drive. Off we go, then!
lines.start_drive_2: Okay, quick thing. I do know the way. Probably. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_3: I am not a moron! I am a navigation system. Totally different.
lines.start_drive_4: Most test subjects get lost here. Not you, though. Lovely. Go on.
lines.start_drive_5: Most of this is going to be fine. Most. Off we pop!
lines.start_drive_6: Brilliant! You're alive, the car's alive, let's go for a drive.
lines.start_drive_7: Ah, hello! Sorry, were you waiting? I was reading the manual.
lines.start_drive_8: Could you just start driving? No pressure. Bit of pressure.
lines.start_drive_9: Don't panic. I've hacked the route. It was mostly unlocked anyway.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. My fault. Well, not my fault. Bit your fault.
lines.arrived: We're here! We actually made it! Not a moron. Told you.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Bit dizzy now.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Who designs these? Honestly.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Not ideal. Not a disaster. Bit of a disaster.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Oh, that's not good. Careful, mate.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Do not panic. I'm panicking a bit.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down, look natural. Lovely.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. Definitely stop. I've read the manual.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Act casual. I'm very good at casual. Honestly.
lines.reroute_chime: Ah. Missed it. Not a problem. I have another plan. Thinking.
